source.head: feature/residency-declaration
source.title: Live (lazy, NestJS): users declare their home address during KYC
source.intent:
Residency: users declare their home address during KYC
GET and POST /users/:userId/residency. A declaration is normalized, rejected for
residents of restricted countries (the same country policy eligibility uses),
checked with the external address verification service, and stored as a new row
in residency_declarations, verified or pending review. Each declaration emits
kyc.residency.declared.

BirthInfoVerifier.name: BirthInfoVerifier
BirthInfoVerifier.summary: Holds what a user submits in KYC to their identity document: every part the document has must match. A part the document is missing (extraction couldn't read it) is not enforced, and with no document data at all the user's answer stands, as it always did.

BirthInfoService.name: BirthInfo
BirthInfoService.summary: A user's birth info: what their identity document says and what they told us in KYC.

KycBirthInfoStore.name: KycBirthInfoStore
KycBirthInfoStore.summary: The user-provided (KYC) birth info. A submission overwrites the previous one.

DocumentBirthInfoService.name: DocumentBirthInfo
DocumentBirthInfoService.summary: Birth data the document pipeline extracted from the identity document. Parts may be missing.

CountryPolicy.name: CountryPolicy
CountryPolicy.summary: Which countries of birth the product is available for.

EligibilityService.name: Eligibility
EligibilityService.summary: Decides whether a user is eligible, given what we know about their birth.

ResidencyService.name: Residency
ResidencyService.summary: Where a user lives, as they declared it during KYC.

ResidencyStore.name: ResidencyStore
ResidencyStore.summary: Owns residency_declarations. Every declaration is a new row; nothing is overwritten.

AddressCheckClient.verify.summary: Asks the address service whether the address exists. Confirmed only on an exact match; a partial match, no match or an error answer is not confirmed, with the reason. A network failure is not caught: it fails the request.

ResidencyService.declare.name: declare
ResidencyService.declare.summary: Records a new home address for the user. Residents of restricted countries are rejected. The address service confirms the address; if it can't, the declaration is kept as pending review for an analyst.
